mapper.sql: w."単語ID", w."旧単語ID", w."見出し語", w."読み", w."見出し語キー", w."読みキー", w."JLPTレベル", w."品詞", w."状態コード", w."備考", w."バージョン", col."書籍", col."分類", col."レベル", col."単語SEQ", COALESCE(col."収録数", 0) AS "収録数", COALESCE(s."学習状態", 'NOT_STARTED') AS "学習状態", COALESCE(s."総合習得度", 0) AS "総合習得度", COALESCE(s."回答回数", 0) AS "回答回数", COALESCE(s."正解回数", 0) AS "正解回数", COALESCE(s."お気に入りフラグ", false) AS "お気に入りフラグ", COALESCE(s."習得済フラグ", false) AS "習得済フラグ", s."最終学習日時", s."次回復習日時"

FROM public."JPN_単語情報" w LEFT JOIN public."JPN_学習状況情報" s ON s."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."書籍", c."分類", c."レベル", c."単語SEQ", count(*) OVER () AS "収録数" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" c WHERE c."単語ID" = w."単語ID" ORDER BY c."レベル", c."書籍", c."分類", c."単語SEQ" LIMIT 1 ) col ON TRUE

where.if: AND (w."見出し語" ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR w."見出し語キー" ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND (w."読み" ILIKE '%' || #{reading} || '%' OR w."読みキー" ILIKE '%' || #{reading} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cb WHERE cb."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND cb."書籍" ILIKE '%' || #{book} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cc WHERE cc."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND cc."分類" ILIKE '%' || #{category} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "wordCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s."習得済フラグ", false)) AS "learnedCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s."お気に入りフラグ", false)) AS "favoriteCount", COALESCE(round(avg(s."総合習得度") FILTER (WHERE s."総合習得度" IS NOT NULL), 2), 0) AS "averageMastery", COALESCE(sum(s."回答回数"), 0) AS "answeredCount" FROM public."JPN_単語情報" w LEFT JOIN public."JPN_学習状況情報" s ON s."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId}
SELECT "単語ID" AS "wordId", "見出し語" AS "word", "読み" AS "reading" FROM public."JPN_単語情報" WHERE "見出し語" = #{word} AND "読み" = #{reading} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_単語情報" ( "見出し語", "読み", "見出し語キー", "読みキー", "JLPTレベル", "品詞", "状態コード", "備考", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{word}, #{reading}, #{wordKey}, #{readingKey}, #{jlptLevel}, #{partOfSpeech}, #{stateCode}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, 'APP' )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_単語情報" SET "見出し語" = #{word}, "読み" = #{reading}, "見出し語キー" = #{wordKey}, "読みキー" = #{readingKey}, "JLPTレベル" = #{jlptLevel}, "品詞" = #{partOfSpeech}, "状態コード" = #{stateCode}, "備考" = #{note}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{updatedBy}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} AND "バージョン" = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."JPN_単語情報" WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId}
mapper.select: SELECT "収録ID" AS "collectionId", "単語ID" AS "wordId", "レベル" AS "level", "書籍" AS "book", "分類" AS "category", "単語SEQ" AS "wordSeq", "掲載見出し語" AS "listedWord", "掲載読み" AS "listedReading", "掲載品詞" AS "listedPartOfSpeech", "掲載中国語意味" AS "chineseMeaning" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} ORDER BY "レベル", "書籍", "分類", "単語SEQ"

SELECT q."問題ID" AS "questionId", q."単語ID" AS "wordId", q."問題種別" AS "questionType", q."問題番号" AS "questionNo", q."問題文_日本語" AS "questionTextJa", q."正解値" AS "correctValue", (SELECT count(*) FROM public."JPN_単語問題選択肢情報" c WHERE c."問題ID" = q."問題ID") AS "choiceCount" FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q WHERE q."単語ID" = #{wordId} ORDER BY q."問題種別", q."問題番号", q."問題ID"

SELECT "詳細ID" AS "detailId", "単語ID" AS "wordId", "内容版数" AS "contentVersion", "詳細JSON"::text AS "detailJson", "AIプロバイダ" AS "aiProvider", "AIモデル" AS "aiModel", "取得日時" AS "fetchedAt" FROM public."JPN_単語詳細情報" WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} LIMIT 1
